gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Noto Sans Devanagari keeps a compact skyline, with capitals melting into the lowercase around them. Noto Sans Devanagari backs up Groovy, whose round letters look bent from wire, with something far quieter.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-duployan: A narrow slit is all that remains of the c in Groovy, while its lowercase drifts loosely apart. And Noto Sans Duployan opens wide, with a gaping lowercase a and oversized counters that undo that tightness.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Groovy squeezes its c nearly shut and spaces the lowercase loosely. Noto Sans Georgian, with open curves throughout and short ascender stems, lets paragraphs of text move along without snagging.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Groovy brings funky, nearly closed letters and constant-width arms and legs to the heading, loosening up the whole page. Noto Sans Grantha then reads smoothly, with no closed-up bowl to snag on.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Noto Sans Gujarati reads cleanly, its curves stopping before they turn inward. Against Groovy, whose stroke never thins or swells, give the body font a bit more size so its open counters show.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-g: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi draws its lowercase with crayon-thick strokes and cuts terminals back to leave a big gap. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi lets paragraphs unroll easily, a breezy counterpoint to the closed-up letters of Groovy.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Friendly and funky, Groovy gives its diagonals as much heft as its verticals. But Noto Sans Hanunoo, with lowercase filling most of the height and open terminals, is what keeps the whole thing readable.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-inscripti: Snug and funky up top, wide-eyed below. Groovy does its best work in big, short headings, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian opens every e and a into wide round eyes.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-jp: A narrow slit where the c nearly closes defines Groovy, whose curves never thin out at the turns. Noto Sans JP sweeps its curves open instead of curling them shut.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: In Groovy, the c nearly seals shut, leaving a narrow slit. Noto Sans Khudawadi leaves its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook, so beside that tight heading it feels approachable and easygoing.
